notes: BETA: fixes the brand-pricing prompt — the Save/Cancel buttons are no longer cut off, and the text is smaller/more compact. Each brand now has a 'Match to existing brand' dropdown, so a wrong or abbreviated name on a quote (like WYC) can be mapped to a brand already in the system; the mapping is remembered for next time. Builds on bundled vendor prices, variable tiers, and emailed support logs.
